fix: RestoreHudAfterCutscene activates and enables hudCamera, activates hudCanvas, enables its PlayMaker FSMs, then sends IN.
directAssertions: HUD camera active and enabled after return on host and guest
HUD canvas active in hierarchy after return on host and guest
HUD FSMs enabled and visible after return on host and guest
connected session and personal profile preserved
limitations: A separate full native boss run reached the story ending but its old settlement fixture initially mishandled scene aliases; the final direct return run uses the exact native C/credits/completion boundary on both endpoints.
The direct roundtrip asserts restored HUD state at the personal checkpoint; it does not add a second full lethal-death sequence inside the same ending case.
No package or installation was requested.
